method: Actual SimulationEngine, observer hooks; sampled food uses route-open plant biomass divided by nearby consumers; Model 2 denominator shares noncarnivores. Window production is solar ledger inflow and consumption is observed plant biomass consumed.

capComparison.method: Temporary isolated source copy; replace cap literal 220 with 260 in engine and behavior, and cap accounting in audit script; Node heap 512 MiB, process timeout 90 s, 10000 ticks. No production files changed.

lagAssociations.method: Within each 10k run, Pearson correlation of end-window median route-open plant biomass per nearby consumer at window t with target at t+lag; 250-tick windows; median and range across nine runs. Descriptive only; simultaneous coupling, climate, age structure, and population denominator can confound.

changeLagAssociations.method: Within-run Pearson correlation of successive 250-tick changes in end-window local-food median with successive changes in target at same or later windows. Descriptive; no causal identification.
